wa.text:
HiEnd Asia 2026, the Singapore Hi-End Asia International Audio Visual Show
17 – 19 Dec 2026, 10am – 7pm daily
Level 3, Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre
Free entry, no tickets needed.
poster.alt: Official poster: 2026 Singapore Hi-End Asia International Audio Visual Show, 17 to 19 December, Suntec Singapore Level 3
stat.days: of listening rooms and live music
video.intro: Listening rooms, founders at the turntable and crates of vinyl: a minute at the 2025 show.
prog.intro: The 2026 programme is yet to be confirmed. Expect keynote talks, daily live concerts and artist meet-and-greets across all three days. The timetable will be published here.
floor.intro: Explore dedicated listening rooms on Level 3 of the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre. Each space is purpose-built to showcase the finest in audiophile equipment: a curated journey through sound, precision and craftsmanship.
floor.alt: Show floorplan of Suntec Level 3: exhibition hall, concert hall, VIP room and numbered exhibition rooms along concourses 1 to 4
floor.cap: Level 3 layout from hiendasia.com. Room allocations may change before the show.
floor.find.intro: Search for a brand or exhibitor, or tap a room, to see where it is and how to get there from the escalators.
kn.intro: Renowned experts and thought leaders in high-end audio share their insights in an intimate setting. Held in private rooms, these sessions go deep, from design philosophies to emerging technologies.
con.intro: A curated lineup of international and Asian artists on the grand stage, voices that reflect the region's languages, traditions and musical depth. From acoustic purity to cultural nuance, each performance is a tribute to the art of listening.
gu.intro: Respected personalities, industry veterans and passionate voices from the audiophile world walk the halls of HiEnd Asia. Their presence is about shared passion, deep appreciation and meaningful encounters.
reps.intro: From founders to chief engineers, the people shaping the future of high-end audio will be in the room. A rare chance to hear the philosophies, craftsmanship and vision behind the world's most respected brands, directly from their creators.
p.11.name: Jack Liu
p.11.bio: Liu Hansheng has edited Audio Art, Taiwan's leading Hi-End audio magazine, since 1988. The monthly covers global audio equipment, tuning tips and new music, and is a key voice in the Chinese-speaking audio world.
p.12.name: Patrick Lee
p.12.bio: A Hong Kong hi-fi reviewer since the 1980s, Patrick shares decades of expertise through magazines, social media and YouTube. His Hi-Fi Circle community has over 40,000 members across Greater China and Southeast Asia.
p.13.name: Richard H. Mak
p.13.bio: Analog editor for Mono & Stereo and Part Time Audiophile, and Analog Master at TONEAudio. A writer for 25 years and an audiophile for 44, he designed AnalogMagik, the world's only all-in-one cartridge setup software.
p.14.name: AdiLance
p.14.bio: A fellow audiophile who shares his journey into music and hi-fi on social media, in a characteristically frank manner that makes a refreshing change for those following along.
p.15.name: John Hsu
p.15.bio: An audiophile for 45 years and a Singapore resident, John has built and tuned a dedicated basement listening room. His interactive session covers psychoacoustics, stereo imaging, room treatment and speaker placement.
p.31.name: Anette Askvik
p.31.bio: Her voice is vulnerable and powerful at once; her music soft and hypnotic, balanced between acoustic and electronic. Four albums in, her recordings have become a global standard for demonstrating and testing audio equipment.
p.36.name: STein Austrud
p.36.bio: Blends classical training with contemporary soundscapes, weaving cinematic textures with lyrical piano. Performs with Anette Askvik at HiEnd Asia.
p.32.name: Anne Bisson
p.32.bio: Celebrated for warm vocals, intimate live performances and audiophile-quality recordings that blend jazz, pop and classical influences.
p.33.name: Zhong Zhigang
p.33.bio: Second place at the 1994 Hunan MTV Singing Contest and one of Shenzhen's Top Ten Singers in 1998 and 1999. Albums include Once Chanted, Night Fire and Just Right.
p.34.name: Kiva
p.34.bio: A Mandarin-language singer-songwriter whose music ranges from soulful ballads to cinematic themes. Nominated for Best Jazz Song for Libra at the 2025 Wave Music Awards.
p.35.name: Henry Heng
p.35.bio: A familiar face on Singapore television for over two decades, best known for his work with Mediacorp across dramas, variety shows and films.
p.40.name: Arthur Hsieh
p.40.bio: Has worked with Golden Melody Award winners including Andy Lau, Ricky Hsiao and Sasha Lee. Founded the LP2D Remaster Station channel in 2012 and the listening space 築SOUND))) in 2022.
p.41.name: Brother Bok
p.41.bio: Malaysia's only professional audio YouTuber presenting in Chinese, known for a humorous, straightforward style: unboxings, store visits and audio know-how.
p.42.name: Hao Wei
p.42.bio: A graduate of the Xinghai Conservatory of Music in vocal performance, known for strong performances and emotional depth. Several albums released since 2020.
brands.intro: Over 150 of the world's leading audio brands under one roof, from legendary pioneers to today's most talked-about names, brought by Singapore's dealers and distributors.
tl.2025: First edition at a world-class convention venue
story.p1: HiEnd Asia has quickly become Southeast Asia's most anticipated high-end audio exhibition. At Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre, at the heart of the city, it brings more exhibitors, more brands and purpose-built listening rooms, just minutes from three MRT lines.
story.p2: As Southeast Asia moves towards becoming half of the global economy by 2030, demand for high-end, lifestyle audio is accelerating. Singapore, a gateway to over 4 billion people within a 7-hour flight, offers global access, pro-business infrastructure and Asian elegance.
visit.intro: Suntec Singapore sits in the heart of the downtown district, near Marina Bay Sands, Gardens by the Bay and the Singapore Flyer.
visit.photo1: Escalators at the entrance to Suntec Singapore Convention Centre
visit.photo2: Suntec Singapore's glass roof lit blue at night
foot.tagline: Sharing our passion for the finer things in life for our five senses, sights, sound, taste, touch and smell with our fellow ASEAN brethren.
foot.motto: Be present. The moment is yours.
meta.desc: 17–19 Dec 2026, Level 3, Suntec Singapore. Free entry. 150+ high-end audio brands, listening rooms, keynote talks and live concerts.
consent.title: Your privacy
consent.text: We'd like to use analytics cookies to see how this page is used, and marketing cookies from Google and Meta to measure our ads. Nothing is set until you choose, and you can change your mind any time.
